FN-843YMHH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 542
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ginny Shaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/15/2025
House Bill 542 as introduced would: (1) provide for full-time prosecuting attorneys in the
district attorney offices and attorneys in the Office of Prosecution Service (OPS) to be members
of the District Attorneys' Plan under the Judicial Retirement Fund; (2) increase the benefit
multiplier for district attorneys under the plain from 3%, under current law, to 4%; and (3)
would allow current district attorneys that qualify for the supernumerary program and the
Employees' Retirement System (ERS) based on separate years of service to participate in both
programs. According to OPS, there are currently 11 district attorneys that would receive benefits
from both the supernumerary program and the ERS.
According to the actuary of the Retirement Systems of Alabama, based on the September 30,
2023 valuation, this bill would: (1) increase the unfunded liability of the District Attorneys' Plan
by an estimated $11 million; and (2) increase the obligations of the various district attorney
offices and OPS, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated cumulative total of
$681,000 annually, due to the higher employer contributions rates for ERS members transferring
to the DA plan.
